name: 오르윈
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Redesign the provided game hero's COSTUME, HAIR and silhouette as described below while retaining their original human/elf species, class, heroic personality and premium Korean fantasy anime PAINTED original-art finish. Output a perfectly SQUARE 2x2 sprite sheet on GENUINE alpha transparency: exactly FOUR full-body poses of the same redesigned hero, one per quadrant: top-left idle, top-right anticipation, bottom-left strike/casting, bottom-right walking. All four exact same body size, costume, hair and camera angle, orthographic 3/4 facing screen-right. EVERYTHING including weapons remains strictly inside its own quadrant, large 60px transparent gutters along every edge at 1024 size; full figure plus weapon uses ONLY 65% of quadrant height/width. Nothing touches the canvas edge or central divisions. No labels, letters, floor, background, shadow or box borders. Fine luminous material painting, sharply detailed ornament, expressive face, distinct silhouette readable at small game size; no photorealism/plastic. DESIGN: Human golden-spear guardian. Give him a very distinct fortress-lancer silhouette: tall rigid bronze half-helmet with a single white horsehair crest, dark chestnut hair visible at temples, serious face with same blue eyes, bulky rectangular tower shield, shortened antique golden spear kept low, broad dark emerald tabard over burnished gold and iron plate, squared layered shoulders, NO royal-blue cape and no sword. Heroic noble champion, not corrupted.
edit_prompt: Edit the supplied redesigned hero sprite sheet. Keep the EXACT character, beautiful painted anime rendering, face, costume, hair and four poses. Make it a clean production SQUARE 2x2 atlas with HUGE transparent gutters: uniformly reduce each complete pose WITH its weapon to 55% of its quadrant dimensions, then place it centered in its own quadrant. No body, spear, sword, cape, staff, hair, glow or sparkle may cross quadrant divisions or touch canvas borders. At 1024 resolution, leave at least 60 pixels transparent on all four sides of EVERY quadrant. Feet matching local baseline in all quadrants, exact same body size. Keep idle top-left, anticipation top-right, attack bottom-left and walk bottom-right. REMOVE all floating spell halos, spell circles, sparks and separate FX painted into the art; retain the weapon itself and fine material edge highlights. No text, no extra hero, no shadow, no floor. Preserve actual transparent alpha and details.
